local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.name: Hugging Face models
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.what: Language, image and speech models that programs downloaded from Hugging Face, one folder per model.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.made: Programs that use Hugging Face's libraries (Python scripts, notebooks, local AI apps).
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.if-r: The model's folder goes to the Trash. A program that needs the model downloads it again; until then, folders that link to its files see them missing.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.come: Yes, by download the next time a program asks for it, which needs the network and can take long for a big model. A gated or private model also needs your Hugging Face login.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.wh: Datasets that programs downloaded from Hugging Face to train or test models, one folder per dataset.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.ma: Programs that use Hugging Face's libraries (Python scripts, notebooks, training tools).
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.if: The dataset's folder goes to the Trash. A program that needs the dataset downloads it again; until then, folders that link to its files see them missing.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.co: Yes, by download the next time a program asks for it, which needs the network and can take long for a big dataset. A gated or private dataset also needs your Hugging Face login.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.name: LM Studio models
local-ai-models.lm-studio.what: The models LM Studio keeps to run them on this Mac, one folder per model.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.made-by: LM Studio, an app that runs language models locally.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.if-removed: The model's folder goes to the Trash and LM Studio no longer lists it. Your chats and LM Studio's settings stay.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.comes-back: If you downloaded it in LM Studio, yes: download it there again. A model you added yourself comes back only from your own copy.
local-ai-models.ollama.name: Ollama models
local-ai-models.ollama.what: The language models Ollama keeps to run them on this Mac: for each model a small list of its files and the layer files it names. Models can share layers.
local-ai-models.ollama.made-by: Ollama, an app and a command that run language models locally.
local-ai-models.ollama.if-removed: The model's list and the layers no other model uses go to the Trash together, and Ollama no longer lists the model. Layers another model uses stay, so your other models keep working.
local-ai-models.ollama.comes-back: If you downloaded it, yes: `ollama pull` with its name downloads it again. A model you made yourself with `ollama create` comes back only from its Modelfile and your files, or from the Trash.
local-ai-models.enabled.label: Local AI models
local-ai-models.enabled.description: Finds models downloaded by Hugging Face, LM Studio and Ollama. Each one goes to the Trash; most come back by download.
local-ai-models.title: {name}
local-ai-models.reason.hugging-face: Downloaded from Hugging Face; last opened or changed on {date}. A program that needs it downloads {size} again.
local-ai-models.reason.lm-studio: Kept by LM Studio; last opened or changed on {date}. Downloading it again in LM Studio takes {size}; a model you added yourself does not come back.
local-ai-models.reason.ollama: Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. `ollama pull {name}` downloads its {size} again; a model you made yourself does not come back that way.
local-ai-models.reason.ollama-shared: Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. It is {listed} in all, of which {size} is freed; the rest is shared with {other} and stays.
local-ai-models.reason.ollama-shared-mor: Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. It is {listed} in all, of which {size} is freed; the rest is shared with {other} and {count} more model and stays.
Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. It is {listed} in all, of which {size} is freed; the rest is shared with {other} and {count} more models and stays.
local-ai-models.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to the system or another user, or is locked, often after a command run with sudo. Removing it needs an administrator.
local-ai-models.left-out.special: It holds a connection a running program may be using, so it is kept.
local-ai-models.left-out.app-open: LM Studio is open and may be using its models. Quit it and scan again.
local-ai-models.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your open apps, so it keeps this. Scan again.
local-ai-models.left-out.ollama-unreadab: One of Ollama's model lists could not be read, so it cannot be told which files its models share. Nothing of Ollama is offered.
local-ai-models.left-out.ollama-download: Ollama is downloading a model, or a download was left unfinished. Let it finish, then scan again.
local-ai-models.left-out.ollama-incomple: Some of this model's files are missing or still being written. Pulling it again in Ollama repairs it.
